name: Personal shopper and deal-hunting service
summary: Find people the right product at the best achievable price, stacking sales, coupons, and cashback, and charge a flat finder fee.

endpoints.description: Price history and best-time-to-buy analysis for a product
Deal stacking — combine sale + coupon + cashback for maximum savings

payment.pricing_note: Prices shown are the live public catalog — the same wholesale sheet agents pay per call. No subscription.
payment.human_onramp: Self-serve starter key (no crypto wallet needed): https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/start/?bp=personal-shopper-deal-hunter — scoped key with a $0.25 trial balance; top up by card (Stripe) or USDC. API: POST https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/api/wholesale/register {contact, scope: "findpulse,dealpulse"}. Email fallback: info@theaslangroupllc.com with subject "Starter key: personal-shopper-deal-hunter".

setup_steps: Do ten free requests for friends this week and keep score: hours saved, dollars saved, both written down.
Set three flat tiers by ticket size and publish them.
Pick a visible niche to start (parents’ gear, home office, gaming) so word-of-mouth has something to grab.
Post one worked example (request, research, the stack, the final price) as your storefront. One honest example outsells any ad.
licensing_notes: None. If you also join affiliate programs for products you recommend, disclose it plainly on every recommendation (FTC endorsement rules); your credibility is the whole asset here.

compliance.earnings: Educational content. No earnings claims or income projections; results depend on operator effort, market, and pricing.
compliance.posture: Flat-fee self-help document preparation where documents are involved: the customer signs and files; the operator never represents clients or works on contingency.
